last.verdict: Investors cheered a clean beat and fast growth in Mastercard's add-on services.

reasons.label: Beat on sales and profit
reasons.text: Revenue rose 14% to $9.8B and adjusted EPS of $5.31 beat the roughly $5.16 expected.

reasons.label: Services growing fast
reasons.text: Value-added services and solutions revenue jumped 19%, outpacing the core payment network's 11% growth.

reasons.label: Resilient consumer spending
reasons.text: Cross-border volume grew 11% and switched transactions 9%, and the company reaffirmed low-teens revenue growth for 2026.

story: Mastercard has posted steady beats, with revenue up 14% in both Q2 and Q3 and rising payments to banks and partners (incentives) trimming results. The stock slipped about 1.5% after April's beat, rose about 3% in July, and now jumped about 4%.
